export CARGO_HOME=/work/cargo

mkdir -p /work/out
rustc --version > /work/out/toolchain.txt
cargo --version >> /work/out/toolchain.txt
rustup component list --installed >> /work/out/toolchain.txt
cargo check --locked --offline --all-targets
cargo build --release --locked --offline
cargo test --locked --offline --all-targets --no-run
RUSTDOCFLAGS=-Dwarnings cargo doc --locked --offline --no-deps
cp target/release/libsmartcindy.rlib /work/out/libsmartcindy.rlib
sha256sum /work/out/libsmartcindy.rlib > /work/out/build.sha256
printf '%s\n' 'SmartCindy Rust foundation compiled; test binaries compiled but not executed; worker /work is noexec.' > /work/out/result.txt
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.swap.max /sys/fs/cgroup/pids.max > /work/out/cgroup.txt
awk '$2 == "/work" {print $2, $4}' /proc/mounts > /work/out/work-mount.txt
